title: BD-1
description: During the Stinger Mantis crew's hunt for the Jedi Holocron, the Companion Droid BO-I befriended Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis. With programming to assist operations in remote or dangerous locations across the galaxy, the Droid was programmed to be the ideal assistant to a research or explorer. In search of the Holocron, the crew eventually located the artifact, and Kestis destroyed it to prevent Vader from using it. BD-I decided to stay with Kestis and his crewmates.
